method: BASELINE. Seat-neutral core in the statute's and the regulation's own terms, with regulative rules where the text states duties, and an applicant seat layer built from it; written straight from the deposited texts with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Kentucky Revised Statutes (LRC; enactments through the 2026 Regular Session; database updated 10/19/2026), KRS 205.193, 205.200, 205.210, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/krs-205-public-assistance-ktap-ssp.txt (retrieved 2026-10-19 UTC); with 921 KAR 2:016 (eff. 2-16-2023) as deposited at ../../../kentucky-administrative-regulations-921-kar-2-015-and-2-016-state-supplementation-and-ktap-standards/registers/source-bundle/921-kar-2-016-ktap-standards-of-need-and-amount.txt. The Section 9(6) cost-of-living factor is an input.

scope: KRS 205.193(2), (3)(b); 205.200(2), (7); 921 KAR 2:016 Sections 3(2), 4(1)-(2), 5(3)(a)-(e), 5(4), 9(2)-(6). Out: technical eligibility and time limits (921 KAR 2:006, not deposited), deeming, lump sums, the new-employment disregard, state supplementation.
seat: the applicant (the parent or relative with whom a needy child lives)
